ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 30-40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in lateral lobe patches against 60-70% low-intensity black pixels covering the central and peripheral areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white regions occupy the medial-to-distal areas of both the left and right lobes, separated by a wide low-intensity black vertical column at the center. The white regions exhibit dense internal speckling of low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees and a defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by high-frequency jagged peaks and valleys; specific prominent notches are visible on the distal third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning from the median notch to the distal tips, paired with a convex leading edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular clusters (1-10 pixel diameter) scattered primarily across the low-intensity black regions of the lower central fluke and the inner margins of the white patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible white linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, including a set of parallel diagonal marks (rake marks) near the center-right and several horizontal scratches within the left lobe white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge serration and multiple punctate and linear scarring patterns consistent with external environmental interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique internal mottling pattern where dark pixels form non-contiguous, organic-shaped clusters within the high-intensity white regions on both lobes.
